title: 2 Kings Bible Quiz - Chapter 15
description: Ten questions on 2 Kings 15: Azariah and Jotham in Judah, and the quick succession of kings in Israel from Zechariah to Pekah.

questions.text: How many years did Azariah reign in Jerusalem?
questions.explanation: Azariah was sixteen years old when he began to reign, and he reigned fifty-two years in Jerusalem.

questions.text: What happened to King Azariah when Yahweh struck him?
questions.explanation: Yahweh struck the king, so that he was a leper to the day of his death and lived in a separate house.

answers.text: He became blind for the rest of his life
He was a leper to the day of his death
He was carried away to Assyria in chains
He died on that very same day

questions.text: How long did Zechariah the son of Jeroboam reign over Israel in Samaria?
questions.explanation: Zechariah the son of Jeroboam reigned over Israel in Samaria six months.

questions.text: What had Yahweh told Jehu about his sons?
questions.explanation: Yahweh had said to Jehu, "Your sons to the fourth generation shall sit on the throne of Israel," and so it came to pass.

answers.text: They would also rule over the kingdom of Judah
They would never sit on the throne of Israel
They would sit on the throne of Israel to the fourth generation
They would reign over Israel forever and ever

questions.text: From which town did Menahem the son of Gadi go up to Samaria to strike Shallum?
questions.explanation: Menahem the son of Gadi went up from Tirzah, came to Samaria, struck Shallum and reigned in his place.

questions.text: What did Menahem give to Pul the king of Assyria?
questions.explanation: Menahem gave Pul one thousand talents of silver, so that his hand might be with him to confirm the kingdom in his hand.

questions.text: Who was Pekah the son of Remaliah when he conspired against Pekahiah?
questions.explanation: Pekah the son of Remaliah, his captain, conspired against him and attacked him in the fortress of the king's house.

questions.text: Which king of Assyria came in the days of Pekah and carried people captive to Assyria?
questions.explanation: In the days of Pekah, Tiglath Pileser king of Assyria took many cities, all the land of Naphtali, and carried them captive to Assyria.

questions.text: Who made a conspiracy against Pekah, killed him and reigned in his place?
questions.explanation: Hoshea the son of Elah made a conspiracy against Pekah, attacked him, killed him, and reigned in his place.
Jotham built the upper gate of Yahweh's house.

answers.text: The upper gate of Yahweh's house
